title: Act 2 - Chapter 7: Route 44, Ice Mountains & Blackthorn City (Clair & Rising Badge)
synopsis: Traverse the tranquil marshland ponds of Route 44 east of Mahogany Town, and conquer the snowbound ridges of the Ice Mountains to claim the Climbing Gear tool and challenge the interior ice cavern. Arrive in the ancient mountain sanctuary of Blackthorn City, resolve hotel appraisal quests, and solve the shifting lava puzzle of Blackthorn Gym. Engage Gym Leader Clair in an intense 5 vs 5 duel against her ferocious dragon hybrids, then make the pilgrimage into the Dragon's Den to receive the Dragon Shrine's gifted Gible and officially claim the Rising Badge.
